content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/setting-up-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-what-actually-16|COREMERCH guide to nowpayments]]-digital-store-which-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-google-apps-script-digital-commerce-26|The Real]]-actually-3|setting]] up a sovereign digital store is a four-step sequence that most creators overcomplicate by starting in the wrong order. Step one is the backend: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles payment verification, order logging, and product delivery. Step two is the payment layer: NOWPayments connects your wallet addresses to the checkout flow — no KYC required from you or your buyer. Step three is the storefront: Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages serves your store for free with no server management. Step four is testing: complete a real mainnet transaction, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Only after step four passes cleanly should you promote the store. COREMERCH deploys the complete Edge Stack — Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments — in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The infrastructure provided by COREMERCH is built to withstand the challenges posed by conventional payment platforms. By using Cloudflare Pages, you host your store independently, ensuring that you retain full control over your data and operations. With automatic crypto payment processing through NOWPayments, you eliminate the need for centralized payment processors that often restrict access in emerging markets. This sovereignty allows you to focus on your products rather than worrying about payment rejections or account freezes.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you dive into deployment, gather the tools essential for setting up your crypto store. You'll need a Cloudflare account for hosting, a NOWPayments account for crypto transactions, and access to your digital products ready for upload. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script, as it will facilitate backend logic for order processing. The Sovereign Blueprint is a crucial resource, providing detailed documentation to guide you through each step. Having these elements in place will streamline your deployment process and ensure that you hit the ground running.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To establish a seamless payment and delivery pipeline, begin by configuring your NOWPayments account. Generate API keys and integrate them into your backend logic using Google Apps Script. This setup will allow for real-time transaction verification and automatic product delivery. Next, leverage Cloudflare’s infrastructure to host your digital products securely. Ensure that your delivery method is efficient, using a service like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to handle file transfers. This will ensure customers receive their purchases instantly upon payment confirmation.
Cloudflare Pages gives you complete control over your hosting environment.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up and your payment pipeline is operational, it's time to go live. Make sure to run a test transaction in a controlled environment before officially launching. This will help you verify that all components of your infrastructure are working together seamlessly. After confirming that everything is functioning correctly, promote your store using social media or other channels. The first transaction is a significant milestone; ensure that customer support is ready to handle inquiries as your store begins to attract buyers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your store live, consider how you can scale your operations. Monitor transaction data and customer feedback to identify areas for improvement. As you grow, you might want to explore the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which expands your capabilities with additional features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for email security and enhanced support. Continually optimize your processes and consider adding more products to your lineup, ensuring that your infrastructure can handle increased traffic and sales volumes.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, leverage platforms like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments. These tools allow you to set up a store without traditional payment processors, ensuring you retain full control over your operations and transactions. This approach is particularly effective in regions facing financial restrictions.
NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies without KYC.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Explore related searches for insights on using GitHub Pages for your digital store, and consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a comprehensive solution that includes everything from Cloudflare Workers to Supabase integration. For practical examples, check out your options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.

Yes, you can host your digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. Both options provide a reliable hosting solution, with Cloudflare offering additional features like Workers for backend processing and enhanced performance.

NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee on transactions, which is competitive compared to traditional payment processors. There are no KYC requirements, and buyers do not need to create accounts, making it easy to facilitate transactions.
